method: Actual compiled MainWindow constructed through its internal BoardStore constructor, with real XAML controls/resources and isolated synthetic images/data. Private action methods and routed handlers invoked offscreen; application resources loaded without Run/OnStartup. Application content measured/rendered at normal and minimum sizes.
boundary: No Window.Show, native HWND, SaveFileDialog, physical mouse/keyboard input, user data, game capture or native focus interaction. Rendering and state integration only.
